description: Riverside Farm cools its milk in Riverside Vat.
Hillcrest Farm cools its milk in Hillcrest Vat.
Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12 monitors Riverside Vat and samples every five minutes.
Vat Temperature Sensor VT-20 monitors Hillcrest Vat and has stayed inside the 4°C band all month.
The Tuesday Vat Alarm fired on Riverside Vat at 04:10 last Tuesday when the vat reached 9.4°C.
Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12 reported the Tuesday Vat Alarm.
A failed Agitator Motor caused the Tuesday Vat Alarm by leaving warm milk pooled at the top of the vat.
The Agitator Motor is part of Riverside Vat.
Ana Reyes maintains Vat Temperature Sensor VT-12.
Ana Reyes is assigned to Riverside Farm.
Ana Reyes replaced the Agitator Motor the same morning, and Riverside Vat was back to 3.8°C by 07:40.
Sam Cole maintains Fuel Level Sensor FL-4.
Sam Cole calibrated the Hillcrest Water Meter on Monday after a brief drift.
Sam Cole is assigned to Hillcrest Farm.
Fuel Level Sensor FL-4 reads the Riverside Diesel Tank.
The Riverside Diesel Tank feeds the Tanker Loading Pump.
The Fuel Monitor Outage started when Fuel Level Sensor FL-4 stopped reporting on Tuesday evening.
The Fuel Monitor Outage was at Riverside Farm.
Milk Collection Run 18 picks up Riverside Farm, scheduled for 05:30 Wednesday.
Milk Collection Run 18 picks up Hillcrest Farm later the same morning.
The Fuel Monitor Outage delayed Milk Collection Run 18 by two hours because pump fuel could not be confirmed.
North Dairy Co-op collects from Riverside Farm on weekday mornings.
North Dairy Co-op collects from Hillcrest Farm.
Ana Reyes works for North Dairy Co-op field services.
Sam Cole works for North Dairy Co-op field services.
The Vat Temperature Policy governs Riverside Vat: escalate above 6°C within 15 minutes, and do not ship until the vat holds under 4°C for one hour.
The Fuel Confirmation Policy holds Milk Collection Run 18 until the diesel tank level is confirmed.
